basic_info.description: Lovingly cared for by the same family for several decades, this spacious barrel front home is ready for a new family to enjoy. Expanded upper level features many of the beautiful original wood details and has 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. Primary bedroom suite has walk-in closet and en-suite bath. Remodeled lower level has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and family room with separate entrance and access to the backyard, perfect for extended family living.  Nice quiet area of Excelsior District with long term neighbors. Located close to shopping and transportation. Don't miss this great home!
